newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan rupee ends up in kerb, seen rising.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan rupee ends up in kerb, seen rising.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee closed 0.02 up at 41.15 to the dollar in kerb market on Thursday amid a high supply of the U.S. currency and is likely to rise further on Friday, dealers said.
"A lot of dollars held back by speculators in anticipation of a devaluation (of the rupee) is likely to enter the market," one dealer said.

The State (central) Bank of Pakistan rate, last changed on October 22, was 40.1200/40.3206 to the dollar. The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates closed at 2.60 percent compared to Wednesday's 2.70 percent.
